ovh_application_key.description: OVH API Application Key (required for authentication)

ovh_application_secret.description: OVH API Application Secret (required for authentication)

ovh_consumer_key.description: OVH API Consumer Key (required for authentication); generated after authorization

ovh_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for API requests to OVH

ovh_use_internal_ip.description: Use the node's internal IP instead of public IP for fencing (if available)

ovh_ipmi_interface.description: IPMI interface type (e.g., 'lan', 'lanplus'); affects protocol security

ovh_retries.description: Number of times to retry failed fence operations

ovh_retry_max_delay.description: Maximum delay (in seconds) between retry attempts (exponential backoff is used)
